title: prng-lattice-lab record schemas
description: Schema-first source of truth for every record the lab persists or emits. store/db.py validates writes against this; report/synthesis.py re-validates on read. Code conforms to this file, never the reverse.

world_seed.description: only for full Randar coordinate inversion

successes.description: trials with a UNIQUE, correct recovery (unique_candidate == ground truth)

method_used.description: roundoff/enumerate = the top-bits box lattice; residue_slice = nextInt(odd) low-17-bit slicing + certified round-off (recover/residue.py); subset_enumerate = bit-length informative-subset lattice + complete enumeration (recover/starved.py); none = not attempted

model.description: leak model the cell observed; absent/null on pre-0.2 rows means top_bits

bound.description: nextInt bound for nextint_odd / bit_length cells; null for top_bits

leaked_bits.description: mean information actually leaked per trial: n*k for top_bits, n*log2(bound) for nextint_odd, mean sum(k-L+1) over the bit-length run. Drives the underdetermined/edge classification and the ideal-hash null instead of n*k.

mean_candidates.description: mean size of the box-consistent state set across scored trials; 1.0 = clean unique recovery, >1 = collisions (recoverability edge). The rule-8 uncertainty-as-range field.

outcome.description: recovered = every scored trial uniquely resolved; ambiguous = collisions present (see mean_candidates); underdetermined = leaked_bits more than half a bit below 48, so no unique state exists (information-theoretic, not a tooling limit); infeasible = the method exists but the trials' certified/complete enumeration cost exceeds the budget, so nothing was attempted (a disclosed solver limit, not a guess); gap = required method not wired (see capability_gap). `trials` counts SCORED trials only. Trials skipped for a disclosed per-trial reason (rejection-shifted window, infeasible enumeration budget, per-trial underdetermination) are itemised in capability_gap.

capability_gap.description: populated INSTEAD of a score when a required method is unavailable; never leave a gap silent

RecoveryDemonstration.description: Reproducible corroborating evidence that licenses a severity upgrade in repoauditor. Not a prior, not an opinion.

DemonstrationArtifact.description: A self-contained, reproducible recovery demonstration emitted by `prng-lattice-lab demonstrate`. This is the payload a human attaches to a repoauditor finding (or an evidence-intake path ingests) as the independent corroborating source that licenses a severity upgrade under normalize/adjudicate. Every artifact carries its reproduction command, lab version, citations and an exact verification against held-back ground truth; nothing here is a claim without a check.

kind.description: msb24 = nextFloat top-24-bit tokens (Randar path); nextint_odd = nextInt(odd bound) tokens (RandomStringUtils idiom, recover/residue); seeded = recover the new Random(seed) constructor seed from outputs (often a wall-clock creation time); mt19937 = full 32-bit outputs of Python's random (exact untempering)

victim.description: generator identity, e.g. java.util.Random or python random.Random (MT19937)

idiom_ids.description: repoauditor weak_rng idiom ids this demonstration corroborates

parameters.description: kind-specific parameters (bound, window, offset, total, seed, warmup)

reproduce.description: the exact CLI command that regenerates this artifact

verified.description: predictions matched held-back ground truth exactly; an unverified artifact must not be used as corroboration

claim_boundary.description: what this artifact does and does NOT establish (it proves the generator class is recoverable from the stated observations; it does not by itself prove the flagged code exposes those observations)

oracle.description: generator that produced the observed tokens: jvm = a real OpenJDK java.util.Random process (adapt.jvm_oracle), lab_model = the lab's port. A jvm artifact is evidence the model matches the real generator beyond the pinned vector.

oracle_detail.description: e.g. the `java -version` line, when oracle == jvm

content_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical record with this field blanked; tamper-evidence for evidence intake

WeakRngCandidateFinding.description: The record the fold-in emits into repoauditor's detect->triage flow. Mirrors CandidateFinding + an RNG demonstration payload. Severity is deliberately ABSENT: repoauditor's normalize/adjudicate owns and licenses severity.

Certificate.description: The uniqueness / false-match proof behind a demonstration's `verified` flag.

candidates.description: consistent-state count from a COMPLETE solver (1 == certified unique); null when the method does not enumerate (e.g. roundoff)

held_out_checked.description: tokens predicted and matched against held-back ground truth

coincidence_bound.description: P(a wrong state reproduces all held-out tokens by chance) ~= 2^(-bits*held_out); may underflow to 0.0

coincidence_bound_log2.description: log2 of coincidence_bound, readable when the bound underflows

certified_radius.description: the residue solver's worst-case round-off radius (<0.5 => one candidate per slice); null for other methods
